crew.overview: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.
crew.title: Deadpool & Wolverine

details.biography:
Lee Min Ho (born October 25, 1998), popularly known as Lee Know, is a South Korean singer and dancer under JYP Entertainment. Lee Know is the main dancer and dance leader for Stray Kids, and also contributes vocally to all their albums. Lee Know has released some solo projects through Stray Kids YouTube channel including a dance he choreographed "Dawn", his solo song "Limbo", the collaboration song "Drive" (with Bang Chan), and a cover of Day6's "Love me or Leave me".

Starting in August 2021, Lee Know was a MC on the show Music Core, but stepped down in October of 2023 due to schedule conflicts. Lee Know appeared on multiple television shows: The Fishermen and the City, Idol Dictation Contest, and Idol on Quiz.
details.name: Lee Know
